language_scope.selection_basis: Fixed before any authoritative A2 capture or frame-yield calculation from pre-existing programme geography, known non-English NeuroAI activity, and strategic coverage objectives.
language_scope.f8_execution_policy: F8 uses only these matched native-language/jurisdiction strata against an English baseline over the same declared jurisdiction; adding or removing a stratum requires a successor analysis universe.

round_start_known_identity_policy: Known identity means any resolved canonical OFFERING identity accepted before the round starts, regardless of whether its current state qualifies for A-P1; this prevents rediscovery of a known offering from being counted as a new identity.
post_world_cutoff_observation_policy: A source may be observed after the world-time cutoff and before the knowledge-time cutoff, but it supports the A2 snapshot only to the extent that attributable evidence establishes the offering identity or relevant state at or before 2026-09-24. Later world changes remain successor evidence and do not backdate the snapshot.
boundary: A2 v1.0 binds every authoritative product-discovery capture and run to one frozen analysis universe and exact round-start known-offering state. It does not establish global completeness, unseen-population size, market share, effectiveness, publication authority, or v4.2 assessment effect.
